title: Eric Weinstein joins Galileo Project, geometric unity UAP physics

tellings.quote: My colleague Eric Weinstein recently joined the Galileo project. We sometimes speculate about the physics of UAPs.

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein joined the Galileo Project, a Harvard-based effort to study UAP, the official term for unidentified objects in the sky, and he and a colleague sometimes speculate together about how such objects might work physically. This is told in Michels's episode on the Harvard study, in the words of a colleague of Weinstein's, around 2021 or 2022. It matters because it puts a well-known thinker on theoretical physics inside a scientific search for these objects.
